propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies (descriptions and all comments) for every match, consuming excessive context (~203 KB for typical queries) and requiring durable summary field in schema

default search results must project only discovery fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with summary truncated to 240 chars and case-preserving snippets extracted from first matching term, without full descriptions or comment bodies
search must support --output json (default) and --output llm (newline-delimited minified keys) while --full restores legacy TicketState JSON; --full --output=llm must exit 2 as incompatible

case-preserving snippet extraction requires parallel searchable string pair (original and lowercased) to locate first positive free-text match and return bounded 240-char window; predicate-only and negation-only queries return null snippet

public library API must overload rebar.search with SearchResult TypedDict for full=False (default) and TicketState for full=True, and MCP search must bind to search_result.schema.json while show remains full-body
live store measurement for SupportsIncremental query must drop from ~203 KB baseline to <25,000 bytes on default search output
